title: Benefit Exhibit: Member Cost Share for Medical Services across the Group Retiree Plans
content:
Member cost share for medical services is scheduled service by service across the six plans of the Employer and Union Group Retiree Plans: Ridgecrest Group Retiree Standard (PPO), Ridgecrest Group Retiree Enhanced (PPO), Ridgecrest Group Retiree Premium (PPO), Ridgecrest Group Retiree Rx Standard (EGWP), Ridgecrest Group Retiree Rx Enhanced (EGWP) and Ridgecrest Group Retiree Rx Premium (EGWP). Copays are in USD; the out-of-network figure is a coinsurance percentage on covered out-of-network services.

| Service | Standard (PPO) | Enhanced (PPO) | Premium (PPO) | Rx Standard (EGWP) | Rx Enhanced (EGWP) | Rx Premium (EGWP) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| In-network primary care visit | 20.00 | 10.00 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| In-network specialist visit | 40.00 | 30.00 | 15.00 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Emergency department visit | 125.00 | 100.00 | 75.00 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| In-network inpatient admission, each admission | 350.00 | 250.00 | 150.00 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| In-network outpatient surgery | 250.00 | 175.00 | 100.00 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| In-network advanced diagnostic imaging | 100.00 | 75.00 | 50.00 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Covered out-of-network services, coinsurance | 20 percent | 15 percent | 10 percent | 0 percent | 0 percent | 0 percent |

## Points of judgement on the exhibit

The inpatient figure is scheduled for each in-network admission, so it stands once for each separate admission rather than once for the plan year.

The out-of-network figure is the only one of the seven expressed as a percentage of the cost of covered services; the other six are fixed amounts per visit, per admission or per procedure.

Every figure in the exhibit is scheduled at 0 on Ridgecrest Group Retiree Rx Standard (EGWP), Ridgecrest Group Retiree Rx Enhanced (EGWP) and Ridgecrest Group Retiree Rx Premium (EGWP).
